rules.statement: The court held that gifts made to heirs, which were intended as dowry or additional dowry, are not subject to collation under the Jaffna Matrimonial Rights and Inheritance Ordinance (Cap. 48) Section 33.
rules.supporting_quote: "I value all the donations at half the face value on the deeds. . . . and hold second, fourth, sixth, and seventh respondents to be entitled to the balance, if any, to make up their shares of the estate. . . . Those respondents are to state in writing within three weeks of the delivery of this order whether they will be satisfied with what they have already received or claim a share of the estate on the terms I lay down"
